title: Following the route and noticing joy

captions.physics: Directing shared play towards a goal

meaning: Your shared game can bring immediate delight when intensifying the experience leaves you free to pause instead of always proceeding.
text: A common aim can belong within a light game. The Chariot in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes coordinated movement: choosing a route, passing stages and meeting a small obstacle together. The Empress in energy leans towards demanding richer experiences, as though one successful discovery could never be enough. The Sun in emotions gives immediate pleasure: amusement, interest and delight in company. A simple tension appears between these roles. Obtaining more means moving onwards, while the warmest impression is already happening and asks for your attention.

Suppose you follow a park trail seeking amusing wooden figures. Beside one, a funny story unexpectedly emerges, but the map points to the next. **Joy has already happened even while the route remains unfinished.** You can linger, laugh and examine the discovery. Completed stages do not measure the closeness of this moment. There is something to share without requiring the next find to exceed the previous one.

When fullness becomes compulsory, the walk turns into executing a programme. You scarcely pause over anything enjoyable and grow irritated by delays. A sunny feeling gives way to showing that everything remains entertaining. The shared path supports play better when its scale can change. One living discovery can give the evening value, even if you leave the other figures for another meeting.
